metadata.name: Active Conjunction Events - Debris vs Communication Infrastructure
metadata.description: Realistic conjunction events showing space debris threatening global communication satellites
metadata.problem_statement: Space Tech & Orbital Sustainability: Build autonomous agents to track space debris, optimize satellite maneuver planning, or coordinate open-source orbital traffic management to protect global communication infrastructure.

conjunctions.threat_assessment: CRITICAL - Debris from Cosmos 1408 ASAT test on direct collision course with Starlink satellite. This debris fragment was created during the 2021 anti-satellite test and continues orbiting at 480km, now intersecting with Starlink's operational altitude.
conjunctions.recommended_action: IMMEDIATE MANEUVER REQUIRED - Probability of collision exceeds 1% threshold. Starlink-1007 should execute avoidance burn within 2 hours.
conjunctions.constellation_impact: If collision occurs, would generate additional debris threatening entire Starlink shell and nearby operations

conjunctions.threat_assessment: CRITICAL - Fragment from the 2009 Iridium-Cosmos collision threatening operational Iridium NEXT satellite in nearly identical orbit. The 2009 collision created this debris, and over 15 years it has evolved to threaten the replacement constellation.
conjunctions.recommended_action: IMMEDIATE MANEUVER REQUIRED - Collision probability of 2.8% is unacceptable. Iridium 102 must perform avoidance maneuver.
conjunctions.constellation_impact: Direct threat to Iridium's voice and data services covering poles and remote regions

conjunctions.threat_assessment: CRITICAL - Fengyun-1C ASAT debris fragment from 2007 threatening OneWeb satellite. Although from a different altitude band, orbital perturbations have brought this fragment into OneWeb's path.
conjunctions.recommended_action: MANEUVER REQUIRED WITHIN 6 HOURS - Probability 1.5% requires action to protect OneWeb infrastructure.
conjunctions.constellation_impact: Could cascade to other OneWeb satellites in similar orbital planes

conjunctions.threat_assessment: HIGH RISK - Cosmos 1408 debris fragment approaching Starlink satellite. Though probability is lower than ID 1, still exceeds 0.1% operational threshold.
conjunctions.recommended_action: SCHEDULED MANEUVER WITHIN 4 HOURS - Execute avoidance burn during next available window.
conjunctions.constellation_impact: Part of ongoing threat pattern from Cosmos 1408 debris to Starlink constellation

conjunctions.threat_assessment: HIGH RISK - Fengyun debris approaching OneWeb satellite. Requires planning but not immediate emergency action.
conjunctions.recommended_action: PLAN MANEUVER WITHIN 12 HOURS - Generate avoidance options and coordinate with OneWeb operations.
conjunctions.constellation_impact: OneWeb provides critical connectivity to underserved regions; protection is essential

conjunctions.threat_assessment: HIGH RISK - Recent Cosmos 1408 debris fragment intersecting Starlink path.
conjunctions.recommended_action: MONITOR CLOSELY - If probability increases, execute maneuver within 6 hours.
conjunctions.constellation_impact: Another Starlink satellite threatened by same debris cloud

conjunctions.threat_assessment: MEDIUM RISK - Requires attention but not urgent. Debris from major collision event crossing Iridium operational band.
conjunctions.recommended_action: PREPARE CONTINGENCY PLAN - Monitor trajectory and have maneuver ready if probability increases.
conjunctions.constellation_impact: Another Iridium satellite potentially threatened by long-lived collision debris

conjunctions.threat_assessment: MEDIUM RISK - Debris from historic collision crossing OneWeb operational altitude.
conjunctions.recommended_action: PLAN AVOIDANCE - Generate maneuver options within 24 hours if probability remains at this level.
conjunctions.constellation_impact: Continuing threat from 2009 collision debris to modern communications infrastructure

conjunctions.threat_assessment: LOW RISK - Distant miss between Fengyun debris and Globalstar satellite. Probability within acceptable operational limits.
conjunctions.recommended_action: CONTINUE MONITORING - No immediate action required but maintain watch through TCA.
conjunctions.constellation_impact: Minimal - Low probability event with margin for error

conjunctions.threat_assessment: LOW RISK - Distant approach between collision debris and Starlink. Below operational concern threshold.
conjunctions.recommended_action: NO ACTION REQUIRED - Probability well below threshold. Continue standard tracking.
conjunctions.constellation_impact: Negligible - No expected impact on Starlink operations

starlink.recommendation: INCREASED MONITORING - Starlink's 550km altitude band is experiencing elevated conjunction rates from multiple debris sources

iridium_next.recommendation: ATTENTION REQUIRED - Iridium NEXT satellites share orbit with debris from the original Iridium 33, creating unique self-targeting risk

oneweb.recommendation: PLAN FOR FREQUENT MANEUVERS - OneWeb at 1200km intersects debris from multiple fragmentation events at different altitudes

globalstar.recommendation: STANDARD MONITORING - Lower threat level currently but subject to similar risks as other constellations

statistical_analysis.most_dangerous_debris_source: Cosmos 1408 ASAT Test (2021) - freshest debris, highest velocity dispersion
